Familiarity with industry-standard tools: Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Jellyfish, or similar. Strong hands-on experience with one or more major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless, and cloud infrastructure automation. Familiarity with cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.) relevant to SaaS platforms. Experience leading globally distributed teams or working in a multinational environment. Familiarity with modern DevOps and SRE practices. Strong communication and influencing skills across executive and technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience in regulated industries (financial services, legal tech, healthcare, etc.).
